## String size

-   Same for all values within a column
-   Shorter strings are padded with blanks
-   Adjust size with length statement

## Search inside strings

-   scan
-   find

## Removing excess blanks

-   compress
-   trim
-   compbl
-   strip

## Combine two or more strings

-   ||
    -   Watch out for excess blanks



## String functions

-   tranwrd
-   substr
-   translate
